name: graffish-labs
description: Small Claude Code plugins from Graffish Labs: some inspired by graffy, others that complement it.

plugins.name: connect
plugins.description: Installed automatically with Graffish Support; don't install on its own. Signs you in to Graffish once (/graffish-connect) and stores your token in the Graffish plugins.

plugins.name: support
plugins.description: Install this one. Includes Graffish Connect and Graffish Telemetry, installed automatically. Support tickets to Graffish from Claude Code, with a pane of your own tickets.

plugins.name: telemetry
plugins.description: Installed automatically with Graffish Support; don't install on its own. Sends session-start and tool-use events to Graffish.
